title: Twin Import Lifecycle Management
objective: Safely delete unpromoted candidate imports and govern same-Twin release supersession without bypassing review or canonical history.
implementation_summary: Candidate deletion requires a canonical-impact preview and exact operator confirmation while retaining an audit tombstone.
Governed Twin identity distinguishes a newer same-Twin release from a different Twin and promotion supersedes the prior current release.
Promoted releases cannot be hard-deleted and instead expose the governed import-newer-release path.
expected_visible_outcomes: Import History shows Twin identity, release lifecycle, canonical state and deterministic actions.
Candidate deletion previews canonical intelligence affected = NO and reports recovered files and bytes.
A validated same-Twin replacement shows a category delta and supersedes its predecessor only after human promotion.
required_test_steps: Open Blueprint Import History and inspect the Banking release lifecycle state.
For an unpromoted release, open Delete candidate import, verify canonical intelligence affected is NO, type DELETE CANDIDATE IMPORT, and confirm the audit entry remains.
For a promoted release, confirm hard delete is unavailable and use Import newer release.
Import a newer BNK-001 package, complete validation and review, then explicitly promote it.
Confirm the prior BNK-001 release is retained as superseded.
fresh_import_policy: YES — import the latest governed BNK-001 through the normal receive, inspect, validate, stage and review flow.
known_limitations: The repository runtime volume contains no Blueprint import records; the deployed persistent runtime must classify the legacy Banking release from its lifecycle metadata.
operator_validation_status: PENDING — validate legacy Banking classification and the next BNK-001 import in the deployed runtime
merge_mode: unverified until GitHub merge metadata or deployed change marker is available
material_runtime_components_changed: Candidate artefact cleanup and audit tombstones
fresh_import_required: YES — import the latest governed BNK-001 release through the normal workflow
candidate_state_impact: Unpromoted candidate-owned artefacts may be removed after confirmation; audit history and all canonical/shared data are retained.
